speech.heard: In Eritrea, 92% of city dwellers live in one city. In USA, it is 7%. Nearly all urban citizens live in its single largest metropolitan area. Djibouti has 71%, Kuwait has 70%, Panama has 68% and Mongolia has 68%. Large economies spread out into many centers. India has 7% and Germany has 5%. China is the world's lowest at 3%. Does one city dominate your country?
